svg.title: One table, two readers
svg.desc: One stored row where every cell carries a label: name is PII, diagnosis is CLINICIAN, county and visits have no label, and case_note is LEGAL. A clinician with PII and CLINICIAN authorisations sees name, diagnosis, county and visits, but the case note is never returned. An analyst with no authorisations sees only county and visits.
svg.text: One row, a label on every cell
